localization.githubDescription: Use Weblate to translate or suggest changes. Reviewed changes become a GitHub pull request; only a merged pull request changes the public locale repository.
localization.workflowStepClone: Translate or submit suggestions in the Weblate workspace.
localization.workflowStepTolgee: A Weblate reviewer approves completed strings and opens or updates a GitHub pull request.
localization.workflowStepPr: Merge after the repository checks and GitHub wording review pass.
localization.deploymentDescription: Merged locale commits are pinned into the PaladinsCat frontend image for reproducible VPS deployments.
